projectDescription: Providence Road is a Baton Rouge nonprofit that guides, nurtures, and strengthens the hearts and minds of at-risk youth through mentorship, community service, character development, and trauma-informed programming.
keyFeatures: Five-stage Cultivation Model (Engage → Connect → Practice → Empower → Greatness)
Big Steps™ peer-affirmation practice for grades 4–12 using the NVITES Arc™
Chasing Understanding® structured reading and metacognition practice for grades 6–12
Weekly community service projects (70+ tons of trash removed from North Baton Rouge)
Trauma-informed mentorship and relationship building for youth ages 10–16
Adventure-based and out-of-town service trips to expand youth horizons
Book club and academic enrichment programming
Partnership with community organizations and institutions
publicApiSurface: Donation portal — one-time and monthly giving (providence-road.org/donate)
Stories From The Road email newsletter subscription
Big Steps™ FAQ PDF (free, school-compatible program)
Chasing Understanding® FAQ PDF and free starter kit
